project.name: Martini Sportswear Ecommerce Platform
project.description: Supported the development and maintenance of a multilingual ecommerce platform for an Austrian premium outdoor sportswear brand. Worked on frontend and backend improvements, ecommerce functionality, performance optimization, and responsive user experiences using Pimcore and modern web technologies.
responsibilities: Developed and maintained Pimcore-based ecommerce features
Implemented responsive frontend components using Bootstrap and JavaScript
Optimized website performance and PWA behavior
Integrated product management and CMS workflows in Pimcore
Enhanced multilingual shopping experience across European markets
Supported interactive UI animations using LottieFiles
Improved SEO and social sharing with Open Graph implementation
Integrated WhatsApp Business Chat for customer communication
Maintained reusable frontend utilities using Lodash and jQuery
highlights: Supported a large-scale multilingual ecommerce platform
Improved frontend responsiveness and UX for outdoor product browsing
Worked on scalable Pimcore ecommerce architecture
Enhanced customer engagement and communication integrations
Contributed to performance optimization and modern web standards
